id: title:Gilbert09:exclude alias columns from clickhouse discovery

review.posthog_relevance: ClickHouse warehouse ingestion and schema discovery
review.reason: Adds a filter to exclude ALIAS and EPHEMERAL columns during ClickHouse schema discovery, accompanied by a test asserting this behavior. This prevents discovery queries from including columns that cannot be selected or are not native, avoiding UNKNOWN_IDENTIFIER failures and preserving only selectable columns.
review.uncertainty: While the code change demonstrates a specific correctness improvement for ClickHouse ingestion, the complete implementation and broader system impact are not fully visible; the tier is assigned based on the observed bounded capability and test, not unverified production outcomes.

observations.limitations: Only supplied hunk IDs are cited. No score assigned.
